user.title: Kramer matrix switcher
user.description: Enter the address of the serial-to-Ethernet bridge the switcher is plugged into.

other.title: Other model
other.description: Enter the size of your switcher. If you are not sure about stored setups, leave it at 0 and add it later with Reconfigure.

data.supports_modes: Supports separate audio and video switching
data.preset_slots: Stored setups (presets) the unit can hold (0 if none)

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the IP address and port.
error.no_reply: Connected, but the switcher did not answer. Check the cable, the machine number and the bridge's serial settings.

abort.already_configured: This switcher is already set up.

names.title: Input and output names
names.description: One name per line, in order. Leave a line blank to use the default.

presets.title: Presets (stored setups)
presets.description: Every slot is listed. Occupied or Blank is read from the unit just now. A description after the dash is a HASS description (not stored on device).

slot.title: Preset slot {slot}
slot.description:
Slot {slot} is **{state}** on the unit.

HASS description (not stored on device): {description}

menu_options.store: Store the present routing in this slot
menu_options.describe: Set or change the HASS description (not stored on device)
menu_options.forget: Forget in HASS – presets on the unit can be overwritten but cannot be deleted

store.title: Store into slot {slot}
store.description:
{warning}

This stores the present video routing, audio routing and mode (Audio follow video or Breakaway) together. A preset on the unit can be overwritten but never deleted.

recall.title: Recall slot {slot}
recall.description:
Slot {slot} will change the routing now. {contents}

A full recall also sets the mode (Audio follow video or Breakaway) that was stored with it.

describe.title: Description for slot {slot}
describe.description: This description is kept in Home Assistant only. It is not stored on the unit.

forget.title: Forget the description for slot {slot}
forget.description:
Forget in HASS – presets on the unit can be overwritten but cannot be deleted.

This removes only the HASS description ("{description}"). The setup on the unit is not changed and the slot will still be **{state}**.

error.too_many_names: More names than the switcher has ports.
error.command_failed: The unit refused or did not answer: {error}
error.description_required: Enter a description, or go back and choose Forget.
error.description_too_long: Keep the description to 60 characters or fewer.
error.description_numeric: A description cannot be only digits, because digits mean a slot number.
error.description_duplicate: Another slot already has that description.

abort.unit_unavailable: The unit is not answering, so its presets cannot be shown. Try again when it is connected.
abort.slot_blank: Slot {slot} is blank, so there is nothing to recall.
abort.preset_stored: Stored the present setup in slot {slot}.

set_route.name: Set route
set_route.description: Send one input to one or more outputs. Inputs and outputs can be given by number or by name.

input.name: Input
input.description: Input number or name. Use Off (or 0) to disconnect, on models that can.

outputs.name: Outputs
outputs.description: Output numbers or names, or all.

store_preset.name: Store preset
store_preset.description: Store the present setup in a slot. Refuses an occupied slot unless overwriting is confirmed. A stored preset cannot be deleted, only overwritten.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: Slot number, or its HASS description.

audio_only.name: Audio only
audio_only.description: Store only the audio routes (models with separate audio).

confirm_overwrite.name: Confirm overwrite
confirm_overwrite.description: Must be true to overwrite an occupied slot.

recall_preset.name: Recall preset
recall_preset.description: Recall a stored setup. A full recall also sets the stored mode.

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: Slot number, or its HASS description.

audio_only.name: Audio only
audio_only.description: Recall only the audio routes (models with separate audio).
